_meta.description: Prototype Pollution probe set for WSTG-INJT-22. protopoll_wordlists.py reads this and writes one wordlist per key below. Edit freely - the script just serializes whatever is here.
_meta.Body_Data: JSON request bodies. Each entry is a JSON object, written to Body_Data.txt as one compact JSON line per entry.
_meta.URL_Hash: Fragment (#...) query-string pollution strings, written verbatim to URL_Hash.txt, one per line.
_meta.URL_Seg: Query-string (?...) pollution strings, written verbatim to URL_Seg.txt, one per line.
